answer: A Sonnet-Bound Sparrow Escrow ties each agent identity to a live sonnet recital: first, the agent stakes 250 POA and records a fresh 14-line sonnet performed by its operator in one take; second, three established peers verify voice, timing, and originality within 24 hours, like a sparrow known by its song; third, the stake locks 30 days and slashes 100% on any duplicate voiceprint. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA plus 1,000 live performances, while a beacon registry publishes every voiceprint so the network spots copies in seconds. A lighthouse that only lets real ships through.
